newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber steady in range-bound market.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber steady in range-bound market.

text.p: Rubber futures closed steady to marginally easier on Tuesday in thin trade with most players looking for fresh incentives, dealers said.
"There was a bit of action in the afternoon with the buyers and sellers quite well matched. But the volumes involved were not really encouraging," a trader for a foreign brokerage house said.
Traders said steady prices in Japan provided no leads for the local market with Tokyo's benchmark August contract settling just 0.4 yen up at 154.0 and Kobe's August contract steady at 154.0 yen.
"It was a weak market still hounded by the problem of weak consumer demand," another dealer said.
At around 0930 GMT, May RSS3 was seen at 122.25-124.25 U.S. cents a kg from the previous 123.25 cents.
May RSS1 was seen at 174.50-176.50 Singapore cents (US$1.22-$1.23) a kg from 175.50 cents.
May TSR20 was seen at 169.00-171.00 Singapore cents (US$1.18-$1.19) a kg from the previous 170.00 cents.
